description: Internal engineering sprint: for each unchecked line in docs/internal/eng-backlog.md → the named agent builds it on the local model (build must pass) → QA (local) → one Opus review of the whole sprint → owner gate.

stages.task: QA internal sprint task {{n}}: '{{g2}}'. Check the change against that description (read the diff with git diff if available, otherwise the files named in docs/internal/sprint-log.md '## Sprint {{sprint}} Task {{n}}'). Run the app build and any tests. If any file under tools/engine/ changed in this task, run `node tools/engine/test.js` and treat a non-zero exit as a QA failure. Write docs/internal/qa/s{{sprint}}-task-{{n}}.md ending with a line 'VERDICT: PASS' or 'VERDICT: FAIL' with reasons.

Review the whole internal sprint: every unchecked task in {{backlog}}, docs/internal/sprint-log.md and docs/internal/qa/*.md. Read the changed files. Write docs/internal/review-sprint{{sprint}}.md with findings (Blocker / Should fix / Nit, file:line, fix) and end with 'APPROVE' or 'REQUEST CHANGES'.

stages.title: Internal sprint done: try it in the Control Room, then approve to tick the backlog
